Sabse strong log hamesha loud nahi hote.
Himmat matlab phir bhi karna.
Himmat sona hai.
Sahas sabhi gunon mein sabse zaroori hai, kyunki sahas ke bina koi bhi gun lagatar nahi chal sakta.
Inaction doubt aur fear paida karta.
Chuppi se sach bahar aata hai.
Khamoshi bolne se zyada safe hai.
Khamoshi power ki language hai.
Khamoshi mein matlab milta.
Khamoshi us cheez ka izzat hai jo na boli gayi.
Khamoshi pavitra hai.
Himmat persistence ki niyyat hai.
Darr shuruat hai, end nahi.
Grit mind ko train karta.
Hile bhi, phir bhi firm raho.
Himmat darr ka hona nahi, usse ladna hai.
Lambe daud ki bajaye, lagataar chhoti chhoti daud hoti hain.
Duniya sabko tod deti—phir kai log tootey jagahon pe strong ban jaate.
Grit charitra banata hai.
Silence sabse badi izzat hai.
